name: Vision InspectionObservation event v1 (EVT-InspectionObservation-v1)
purpose: Publish immutable Vision perception evidence for one inspection-image artifact version, with uncertainty and pipeline provenance, for RCA evidence, Twin projection and Core normalization into the separate IC-VIS-002 InspectionResult.
authority_level: Vision perception evidence only; no quality disposition, hold, root-cause or acceptance authority
security_classification: Internal inspection metadata; no image bytes, storage keys, signed URLs, credentials or Oracle labels

semantics.consumed_identities: core.order-query.v1 Lot, SerializedComponent and RouteVisit id/revision; cap.artifact-ref/v1 artifact identity and checksum
semantics.immutability: An observation is never edited; a re-run or human review is a new observation
semantics.replay: Consumers may replay; replay never executes an action or changes quality state
semantics.compatibility: Initial version; IC-VIS-002 InspectionResult is a separate Core-owned contract, not an alias
